name: selection-bar
title: Selection bar and lasso
description: A glass toolbar over the person's selection: how many cards are selected, then Comment, Move to, Zoom to selection and Clear. Centred above the selection, below it when there is no room, drawn above the cards and moving nothing; it follows pan and zoom. A lasso that touches no card gets the area bar, which only offers Zoom to this area. The dashed lasso box (.vb-lasso) is styled here too (Architect .selbar and .lasso; 3_FE_02 rulings 1-2).

files.core: selection-bar-core.ts (placeBar, barView, boxBetween, touches, boxAround; no DOM)
files.template: selection-bar-template.ts (selectionBarTemplate: the only place the markup is built)
files.styles: selection-bar.css (scoped by the tag, and .vb-lasso; tokens only)

parts.vb-sb-count: '3 selected'; absent on the area bar
parts.vb-sb-btn: one button per command the page passes (data-command); vb-sb-primary for Comment

attributes.data-side: above | below: where it sits by the selection (set by place)
attributes.hidden: set by the page whenever the selection is empty or a note bubble is open

methods.show(v: BarView): draws it from selectionBarTemplate; redraws only when what it says changed
methods.place(p: BarPlacement): left, top and data-side from placeBar, in its offset parent's pixels

events: vb-command (bubbles): detail { command }, the id of the pressed button from the page's command table
whenToUse: Acting on several selected cards at once, or zooming to a lassoed area.
whenNotToUse: Actions on one card (its own footer buttons and keys), or anything that needs a typed answer (the note bubble).
accessibility: role=toolbar with a name. Every command also has a key (N or C comment, Z zoom to selection, Esc clears), and the selection itself is announced by the board's polite live region. Real buttons with visible labels and a focus ring. The lasso box is decoration (pointer-events none); the keyboard route to a group is Space on each card.
